newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics sees sales up, charge in Q4.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics sees sales up, charge in Q4.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said on Thursday that it expects about $290 million in net sales for October, a figure that it said is nine percent ahead of its sales plan for the month.

The company said strong sales reflect its purchase of Merisel's European and Latin American operations in September and the company's own operations. It said sales in Britain, Austria and France are 18, 10 and 40 percent above plan respectively.
However, the company also said its fourth quarter could include a charge for employee severance and closed facility costs. It said an amount has not been determined yet.
